svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 07/12 Shade Walks (Common)
svg.desc: New buildings, wide walkways, shade overhead. By afternoon you learn to walk from shadow to shadow. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
